objective: Build a comparable f2+f3 sample across four distinct Premier League team profiles without forcing a wager on every match.

teams.name: Arsenal
teams.selectionReason: Use a stable title-level side to measure favourite pricing, handicap coverage and defensive-score calibration.

teams.name: Brighton & Hove Albion
teams.selectionReason: Use an attack-led, higher-event profile to test goal-total and score-distribution forecasts.

teams.name: AFC Bournemouth
teams.selectionReason: Use a strong recent draw profile and European schedule to test draw probability and fatigue adjustments.

teams.name: Manchester United
teams.selectionReason: Use a heavily followed Champions League side in a new-cycle season to measure price/model disagreement and lineup sensitivity.

evaluation.f2WeightRule: Keep f2 weight at zero until at least 100 chronologically matched predictions show at least 1% holdout RPS improvement.
